decisions.change: Prioritize the shoes-only return, explicitly keep the jacket, and leave task start and exact approval to the trusted host.
Explain both reached draft routes: printed labels require a printer; QR drop-off has a deduction and changed the observed destination to store credit. Do not treat either draft as completion.

Separate selected choices and preserved refund intent from observed source values. Render current amounts from runtime data, flag mismatches and unknown terms, and provide explicit Validate and Restore controls.
Generate informational cards from discovery flows and reached screens, with observed fallbacks. Show actual reached labels rather than assuming route names establish outcomes.
Keep incomplete exploration, the unreached product path, and the recorded source exception visible without inferring transaction failure or success.

Use high-contrast forest text on cream, visible native-control labels, keyboard focus outlines, a live status region, responsive stacking, and disabled actions during host processing or after a receipt.
